== Sounio ==

{{works with|Sounio|v1.0.0-beta.6}}

<lang sounio>extern "C" { fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 }

struct Point { x: f64, y: f64 }

impl Point {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Point {
        Point { x: x, y: y }
    }

    fn distance(self: &Point, other: &Point) -> f64 {
        let dx = self.x - other.x
        let dy = self.y - other.y
        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    }

    fn translate(self: &!Point, dx: f64, dy: f64) with Mut {
        self.x = self.x + dx
        self.y = self.y + dy
    }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut {
    var p1 = Point::new(0.0, 0.0)
    let p2 = Point::new(3.0, 4.0)
    let d = p1.distance(&p2)
    println(d)             // 5.0
    p1.translate(1.0, 1.0)
    println(p1.x)          // 1.0
}</lang>

Output:
<pre>5.0
1.0</pre>

Note: Sounio <code>impl</code> methods require explicit <code>self</code> type annotations: <code>self: &Point</code> for read-only methods and <code>self: &!Point</code> for mutating methods. The <code>Mut</code> effect is required for mutating methods.
